nix.description: Off by default because it shells out to `nix`. The Renovate image has it, and without this the toolchain in flake.lock is the one thing nothing ever bumps.

gradle.description: Android does not use gradle dependency locking, so there is no lock file to maintain — left on, this opens an empty PR every week.

packageRules.description: Backend. Cargo manifests carry loose constraints (`serde = "1"`) on purpose, so patch and minor moves show up as Cargo.lock maintenance rather than manifest churn.
Dashboard and site. `bump` rather than the default `replace`: an in-range update leaves package.json untouched, and a floor nobody ever raises is how a dependency quietly rots.

TypeScript 7 is the native port, and it no longer exposes `ts.factory`: openapi-typescript builds the generated schema through it, so `just gen` dies before the parity chain runs, and `astro check` says outright that the API it needs is missing. Held rather than left to reopen the same PR every week — lift this once both toolchains ship a 7-compatible release.
The ones that move the Roborazzi goldens. Grouped with an okhttp patch, a re-recorded screenshot has no single cause to point at.
Renovate reads xcodegen's project.yml directly, so the SPM packages are managed even though there is no Package.swift.

Every image, wherever it is declared: the Dockerfile, the compose file self-hosters run, and the postgres service ci.yml tests against. postgres must move in all of them at once or CI stops testing what is deployed.
